name: Elias Higbee
role: Missouri judge, high councilor, and temple committee member
dateNote: He asked the questions on Isaiah 52 answered at Far West in March 1838.
importance: Section 113 records his questions about Isaiah 52, on putting on strength and loosing the bands of Zion’s neck. He was a Caldwell County judge and a member of the Far West high council. In 1839–1840 he went with Joseph Smith to Washington, D.C., to seek redress for Missouri losses. He was later appointed to the Nauvoo temple building committee.
connections: He traveled with Joseph Smith to Washington, D.C., and worked with the Far West and Nauvoo Church leaders.
reviewNote: Birth (23 October 1795, New Jersey), baptism (1832), judgeship, high council, Washington trip, temple committee, and death (8 June 1843) checked on JSP.
